record_title: Exact normalized-arcsine image and sharp strong-starlikeness
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The result corrects the exact image geometry and proves a sharp strong-starlikeness consequence for the starlike Ma--Minda class. It does not invalidate the source paper's coefficient or Hankel-determinant results, does not claim novelty for classical sine/arcsine conformal identities, and makes no claim for the companion convex class because the most relevant full text there was not inspected. Residual overlap risk therefore remains for arXiv:2607.27293v2. No independent validation is asserted.
